domain:server#5 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cy1y7UNVbT2QAdmgdn

**Measured on `main` e540baf8 (area E1, pilot #33059) · 2026-11-14T15:05Z. Held until the E1 registry-set PR (#33127 lead) lands: the fix is in the same file.**

Shape: X is a module of App A and ships `welcome` en-US. W (another namespace, depends on X) ships de-DE (L) and en-US.

| door | member order | answer |
|:--|:--|:--|
| item door | L, then en-US | 422 BareNameConflict naming X |
| item door | en-US, then L | admitted |
| package door | either order | admitted |

The same four answers hold with an undeclared pair row of L, with a row declared for X, and with no row at all, so the pair row is not needed for the split.

Where: `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`, `SchemaRegistry#registerItem` (the bare-name item-seam gate's incoming holding reads only registered members plus the arriving one) and `SchemaRegistry#bareNameHoldersOtherThan` (once the first member is admitted, later members skip judgement).

Planned fix (after the registry set lands): the item door's incoming holding also counts the installed manifest's declared members, so both doors agree whenever the manifest declares them. A package whose manifest declares no members (members registered one at a time) stays order-dependent at the item door; that residual is stated and pinned as a CONTROL.
